business_summary: KB Autosys Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells brake pads for the automobile industry in South Korea and internationally. It offers front/rear brake pads, drum brake linings, and lining shoe assembly products. The company was formerly known as Korea Beral Co., Ltd. and changed its name to KB Autosys Co., Ltd. in January 2010. KB Autosys Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Asan-si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: KB오토시스(주)는 국내외 자동차 산업용 브레이크 패드를 제조, 판매하는 회사입니다. 앞/뒤 브레이크 패드, 드럼 브레이크 라이닝, 라이닝 슈 조립 제품을 제공합니다. KB오토시스는 1985년에 설립되었으며 본사는 대한민국 아산시에 위치하고 있습니다.
